summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine business update: the opening of three new Canna Cabana cannabis retail locations in Canada, pending regulatory approval, bringing its store count to 232. The release includes store details and CEO commentary on expansion strategy, funded from internal cash flow. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. This is an ordinary operational announcement, not a transaction requiring special-situations classification.
